items.question: Which divine power stationed in the front corner is identified as holding the depicted emblems?
premises: The preceding verses describe figures holding boon, fearlessness, and a nectar vessel.
A power is described as standing in the front corner.
That power is explicitly declared to be Rudraśakti.
items.inference: The Rudraśakti stationed in the front corner is the one identified as holding those emblems.
uncertainties: The exact referent and agreement of dadhato in relation to rudraśaktiḥ are contextually inferred.
items.plain_english: And the Rudra-śakti, standing in the front corner and holding them, is declared.
